description: European Medicines Agency (EMA) human medicine supply shortages (EMA shortages JSON): medicine, INN, shortage status, affected forms, availability of alternatives, start and expected resolution dates. Shortages only; safety signals and pharmacovigilance data are not included. Up to 20 per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_ema_human_medicines when you need European Medicines Agency centrally authorised human; health_fda_drug_shortages when you need FDA drug shortage listings: generic name, availability. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Medicine or INN words, letters, spaces and hyphens, 2 to 60 characters
